summary: TherapiShots OTP auth increment E2E PASSED. Backend: 31/31 pytest pass against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — covers config, NEW OTP auth (register happy-path returns dev_code+mock=true+token, verify issues JWT that works on /api/auth/me, register missing name/dob -> 400, register under-18 -> 403, register duplicate phone -> 400, login-no-account -> 404, verify wrong code -> 401, demo phone +919999900000 login+verify+/me returns phone, 20s resend cooldown observed as 429 on immediate second send), check-ins (create, multiple/day, unknown mood 400), today/insights.daily_moods(7 entries)/pulse/progress, psychologists (list, detail with availability, 404, requires auth), bookings with MOCK payment (paid+provider=mock+MOCK- txn id, cancel flips status), and auth enforcement on 6 protected endpoints. Frontend (Expo web preview, mobile 390x844): Onboarding -> age-confirm -> Get started -> Register (name/phone/dob) -> Send code -> dev-code-box shows 'Dev code (no SMS yet): NNNNNN' -> otp-input -> Verify -> lands on Today (today-mood-hero visible) -> Me tab shows the new phone number. Login flow with demo phone +919999900000: phone -> Send code -> dev-code-box -> Verify -> Today. Regression on demo user: tapping Hopeful quick-logs (Saved indicator), Insights loads 7-day mood strip, Progress loads, Support -> Find a psychologist card visible, Me shows +919999900000. No blocking issues.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking Expo web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Emitted by some RN/Expo internal component; not from user code paths that were tested. No functional impact.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate source of 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' console warning; migrate to style.pointerEvents if it originates in the app's own components.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/auth/request-otp: correctly rejects under-18 (403), duplicate phone (400), missing name/dob (400 for register), and 404 for login with unknown phone. Returns dev_code+mock=true as documented — clearly labelled MOCK.

server.py /api/auth/verify-otp: on first successful register-verify it inserts the user (with phone, optional email, dob, default consents) AND calls seed_history — so new accounts land in the app with 6 weeks of history immediately. Good.
server.py startup: creates unique sparse index on users.phone and idempotently seeds the +919999900000 demo user with history. Solid.
server.py 20s resend cooldown returns 429 correctly; verified via back-to-back POST /auth/request-otp.

Legacy email/password endpoints /api/auth/register + /api/auth/login are still mounted but unused by the UI — acceptable for now; consider marking deprecated or gating behind a feature flag before shipping.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_therapishots_api.py (rewrote email/password auth tests to cover the new OTP flow: request-otp -> dev_code -> verify-otp; kept coverage of check-ins, analytics, psychologists, bookings)
